text: Still grieving after her sister kills their parents and herself, the American student Dani follows her distant boyfriend Christian and his friends to [a nine-day midsummer festival in rural Sweden|trigger|saying yes to an offer], held once every 90 years at their friend Pelle's commune, the Hårga. On the second day they watch [two elders leap from a cliff|who_suffers|the old, sick and dying], a rite every member performs at 72. As other guests vanish, Dani is [crowned May Queen after a maypole dance|images|gatherings, games and closeness] and Christian is drawn into [a ritual meant to make a child|wants|a child to take or have].
